title: Monitoring Tools

header.html: Describe the purpose of Azure Advisor; Describe Azure Service Health; Describe Azure Monitor, including Log Analytics, Azure Monitor alerts, and Azure Monitor Application Insights
the official AZ-900 study guide, skills measured as of July 20, 2026

html:
1Three tools, three questions

Tool Question it answers Looks at
Azure Advisor "How can I improve my resources?" Your configuration and usage
Azure Service Health "Is Azure itself having a problem that affects me?" The Azure platform and your regions and services
Azure Monitor "What is happening in my resources and apps, and who should be told?" Telemetry (metrics and logs) from your resources and applications

2Azure Advisor

Azure Advisor is a free, personalized recommendation engine that analyzes your resource configuration and usage and suggests how to improve.

It gives recommendations in five categories:

Category Example recommendation
Reliability Use availability zones or backups for a VM
Security Enable MFA, fix issues found by Defender for Cloud
Performance Use a larger tier or add caching
Cost Shut down or resize idle or underused VMs; buy a reservation
Operational excellence Follow best practices for deployment and management
  • Recommendations have an impact level and often a fix button.
  • You can postpone or dismiss a recommendation and set alerts for new ones.
Exam tip

. "Get personalized recommendations to improve reliability, security, performance, cost and operational excellence" → Azure Advisor. It advises; it does not change anything on its own.

3Azure Service Health

Azure Service Health keeps you informed about Azure service issues and planned maintenance that affect your resources. It is made up of three views:

View Meaning
Azure status A global page of the overall health of Azure services and regions
Service Health A personalized view of problems, planned maintenance and health advisories that affect the services and regions you use; you can set alerts
Resource Health The health of one specific resource (for example a VM), including past incidents and guidance

Service Health covers three types of events: service issues (outages happening now), planned maintenance and health advisories (changes that may require your action, such as a retirement).

Exam tip

. A problem in Azure itself → Service Health. Is my one VM healthy? → Resource Health. A global status page → Azure status. Improve my own setup → Advisor.

4Azure Monitor

Azure Monitor is a comprehensive platform to collect, analyze and act on telemetry from Azure, on-premises and other clouds.

Part What it does
Data sources Applications, operating systems, Azure resources, subscriptions and tenants
Data stores Metrics (numbers over time, near real time) and logs (events and records)
Insights and analysis Dashboards, workbooks and visualizations
Respond Alerts, autoscale and automated actions

Log Analytics

Log Analytics is the tool in the Azure portal for querying and analyzing log data stored in a Log Analytics workspace. You write queries in the Kusto Query Language (KQL) to search, filter and summarize logs, for example to find the errors that happened in the last hour.

Azure Monitor alerts

Alerts notify you or run an action when a condition is met, such as CPU above 90% for 10 minutes or a certain log entry appearing.

Part Meaning
Alert rule The condition to watch (a metric, a log query or an activity event)
Action group Who or what is notified or triggered: email, SMS, push notification, voice, a webhook, a Logic App, a Function or an ITSM tool
Severity How serious the alert is

Application Insights

Azure Monitor Application Insights is an application performance management (APM) feature that monitors live web applications.

It detects and diagnoses:

  • Request rates, response times and failure rates.
  • Exceptions and dependency problems (such as a slow database call).
  • Page views and user behavior.
  • Availability tests that check from different locations whether the app responds.
Exam tip

. Query logs with KQL → Log Analytics. Notify when a metric crosses a threshold → alerts. Monitor a web app's performance and exceptions → Application Insights.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors wants personalized recommendations to cut cost and improve reliability for its existing resources. Which service should it use?

  • AAzure Service Health
  • BAzure Policy
  • CAzure Advisor
  • DAzure Arc
Show the answer

Answer: C. Advisor analyzes configuration and usage and recommends improvements in five categories.

S2An administrator wants to be notified when an Azure outage or planned maintenance affects the regions and services in use. Which service fits?

  • AAzure Service Health
  • BAzure Advisor
  • CAzure Cost Management
  • DMicrosoft Purview
Show the answer

Answer: A. Service Health gives personalized information about Azure service issues and planned maintenance.

S3A team needs to write queries to find error entries in collected log data. Which feature fits?

  • ALog Analytics
  • BAzure Advisor
  • CResource locks
  • DVNet peering
Show the answer

Answer: A. Log Analytics queries log data with KQL in a workspace.

S4A company wants an email sent when a VM's CPU stays above 90% for ten minutes. What should it configure?

  • AA tag named CPU on the virtual machine
  • BA management group for the virtual machines
  • CAn Azure Monitor alert with an action group
  • DA delete lock on the virtual machine
Show the answer

Answer: C. Alert rules watch conditions and action groups notify or act.

S5Which feature monitors the response times, failures and exceptions of a live web application?

  • AAzure Advisor recommendations
  • BAzure Site Recovery for the web app
  • CAzure DNS records for the web app
  • DAzure Monitor Application Insights
Show the answer

Answer: D. Application Insights is application performance monitoring.

S6Which Service Health view shows the health of one specific virtual machine?

  • AAzure status
  • BCost analysis
  • CCompliance score
  • DResource Health
Show the answer

Answer: D. Resource Health reports on an individual resource.

5.2 Recall questions

R1Name the five Advisor categories.

Show the answer

Reliability, security, performance, cost, operational excellence.

R2What are the three types of Service Health events?

Show the answer

Service issues, planned maintenance, health advisories.

R3What language does Log Analytics use for queries?

Show the answer

Kusto Query Language (KQL).

R4What two parts does an Azure Monitor alert use?

Show the answer

An alert rule (the condition) and an action group (who or what is notified).

R5What does Application Insights monitor?

Show the answer

Live web applications: requests, failures, exceptions, performance and availability.

R6Which two data types does Azure Monitor store?

Show the answer

Metrics and logs.

6Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Advisor free personalized recommendations: reliability, security, performance, cost, operational excellence
Service Health Azure platform issues, planned maintenance, health advisories for your regions and services; Azure status, Service Health, Resource Health
Azure Monitor collect and analyze metrics and logs; alerts, dashboards, autoscale
Log Analytics query logs with KQL in a workspace
Alerts alert rule plus action group (email, SMS, webhook)
Application Insights application performance monitoring for web apps
